title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14
runtime: material (see info files); hosted by gdlive.com

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy show highlighted by a flawless full‑Anthem of the Sun second set and standout Dark Star/China Cat/Scr‑Eleven performances.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as the best of a stellar February run, with tight playing, smooth transitions and an almost complete Anthem of the Sun sequence that mirrors the album. Reviewers note crystal‑clear soundboard audio and superb mixing, making the show both sonically and musically outstanding.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed five‑star review emphasizes a high‑energy performance with many standout moments and an excellent soundboard mix; no contradictory feedback is present.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Excellent audio and mixing, crisp and clean throughout; reviewers report no noticeable drop‑outs or balance issues.

standout_songs: Caution (Do Not Stop On The Road)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, flawless transitions throughout; the second set reproduces the Anthem of the Sun album in order, creating a cohesive and powerful arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'in the zone' with masterful rhythm guitar licks and poignant dedication to Neal Cassady; his playing drives many jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for artful improvisation after vocals, especially during New Potato where he is given space to solo.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ/keyboard work highlighted as a strong backbone for The Eleven and other jams.
